caveats: Host-only model requires known wave creation sequence, runtime M0, evaluated ISA payload and preinitialized GDS counter state. These are not available from static shader bytes.
Workgroup execution order in Vulkan not guaranteed. Atomic operations or GPU spin-wait would violate guest ordered semantics or deadlock.
Epoch boundary is caller-supplied, not proof every wave reaches the same instruction; multi-pass render/compute shader continuation needs a dedicated safe capture-and-resume protocol.
Separate SRT Phi and walker errors remain unresolved; no gameplay recovered.
